You are working on a React/TypeScript app at /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/instantresumeranker.

## Task
Enhance `src/components/admin/CreditPacksTab.tsx` to support **manually linking an existing Dodo product** to a credit pack. The user already created a product in the Dodo dashboard and wants to connect it — they should be able to paste in the Product ID and Credit Entitlement ID directly, verify the link works, and have a clear step-by-step setup guide.

## What to add

### 1. Form fields in the create/edit dialog
Add two new optional text fields below the existing Name/Price/Credits fields:

**"Dodo Product ID (manual link)"** — text input, placeholder `prod_xxxxxxxxxxxx`  
**"Dodo Credit Entitlement ID (optional)"** — text input, placeholder `ce_xxxxxxxxxxxx`

These are optional — if filled, skip auto-creating on Dodo and use these IDs directly.

State: extend the `form` state to include `dodo_product_id_input: ""` and `dodo_credit_entitlement_id_input: ""`

### 2. Logic change in `save()`
Currently `save()` always calls `syncDodoProduct("create", ...)` when creating new.

Change the logic:
- If `form.dodo_product_id_input` is filled → use it directly (manual link mode):
  - For new pack: insert DB record with `dodo_product_id: form.dodo_product_id_input.trim()` and `dodo_credit_entitlement_id: form.dodo_credit_entitlement_id_input.trim() || null`
  - Then call `syncDodoProduct("verify", { product_id: form.dodo_product_id_input.trim() })` to confirm it exists on Dodo
  - Show success "Linked to existing Dodo product ✓" or warning if verify fails
- If empty → existing auto-create behaviour unchanged

Also pre-populate these inputs when editing an existing pack (in `openEdit`).

### 3. "Verify & Link" button in the dialog
When either manual ID field is filled and editPack exists (not "new"), show a small "Verify & Link" button next to the Product ID input that:
- Calls `syncDodoProduct("verify", { product_id: productIdInput })`
- Shows inline result: green checkmark + product name from Dodo if found, red error if not
- Updates DB with the entered IDs on success

### 4. Setup guide section (collapsed by default)
At the bottom of the dialog, add a collapsible `<details>` section (or shadcn Collapsible) titled **"Setup Guide — How to connect a Dodo product"** with these steps:

```
Step 1: Log in to app.dodopayments.com → Products → Create New Product
Step 2: Set Name (e.g. "100 Credits — $10"), Price (one-time), Tax Category: SaaS
Step 3: Copy the Product ID (starts with prod_) from the product detail page
Step 4: Under "Credit Entitlements" tab, create an entitlement:
         Name: "$10 - 100 Credits" | Unit: credits | Rollover: disabled
Step 5: Copy the Credit Entitlement ID (starts with ce_)
Step 6: Paste both IDs into the fields above and click "Verify & Link"
Step 7: Save the pack — the app will verify the product exists and link it
```

Also add a short note: "Credits are tracked by your app (not Dodo) for wallet top-ups. For fixed packs, Dodo credit entitlements track the grant."

### 5. Below the table — static "Manual Setup Steps" info card
Add a small info card below the packs table (collapsed by default using a toggle button) titled **"Quick Setup Reference"** with:
- A 2-column mini table showing what each field maps to in Dodo
- One-time setup checklist in brief
- Link to Dodo dashboard: https://app.dodopayments.com

## Rules
- Only edit `src/components/admin/CreditPacksTab.tsx`
- Keep all existing logic intact — just extend it
- Use shadcn `Collapsible` from `@/components/ui/collapsible` for the setup guide collapse
- Use existing imports where possible (Label, Input, Button, Badge, etc.)
- Add `ChevronDown` to the lucide imports
- The manual ID fields should have a small info tooltip/text: "Fill these only if you already created the product in Dodo manually. Leave blank to auto-create."
- After verify success, show the product name from Dodo response inside the dialog
- Run `npm run build` at the end to verify no type errors

Read the current file first at:
/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/instantresumeranker/src/components/admin/CreditPacksTab.tsx

Then make all changes and run the build.

Build passes with zero type errors. Here is a summary of every change made to `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/instantresumeranker/src/components/admin/CreditPacksTab.tsx`:

---

### What was changed

**Imports**
- Added `Collapsible, CollapsibleContent, CollapsibleTrigger` from `@/components/ui/collapsible`
- Added `ChevronDown` and `Info` to the lucide-react import line

**Types and constants**
- Extracted a `FormState` type with the two new fields: `dodo_product_id_input` and `dodo_credit_entitlement_id_input`
- Added `EMPTY_FORM` constant to keep `openNew` and reset logic DRY
- Added `SETUP_STEPS` array (the 7-step guide) and `FIELD_MAP` array (the 5-row field mapping table) as module-level constants

**New state variables**
- `dialogVerifying` — boolean spinner state for the in-dialog Verify & Link button
- `dialogVerifyResult` — holds `{ exists, is_active, name }` for the inline result banner
- `showSetupGuide` — controls the setup guide Collapsible inside the dialog
- `showQuickRef` — controls the Quick Setup Reference card below the table

**`openNew` / `openEdit`**
- `openNew` now resets to `EMPTY_FORM` (includes the two new fields) and clears `dialogVerifyResult`
- `openEdit` now pre-populates `dodo_product_id_input` and `dodo_credit_entitlement_id_input` from the pack's existing DB values

**`handleDialogVerifyAndLink` (new function)**
- Calls `syncDodoProduct("verify", { product_id })` with the manually-entered product ID
- If editing an existing pack and verification succeeds, immediately writes both IDs to the DB and invalidates the query cache
- Updates `dialogVerifyResult` for the inline banner; toasts success or error

**`save()` changes**
- For new packs: if `dodo_product_id_input` is filled, inserts the record with those IDs pre-set, then calls `syncDodoProduct("verify", ...)` to confirm — shows success or warning accordingly. Otherwise falls through to the original auto-create path.
- For existing packs: if `dodo_product_id_input` is filled and differs from the current linked ID, writes the new IDs to DB and calls verify. Otherwise the original update/re-create/sync path runs unchanged.

**Dialog UI additions**
- "Manual Dodo Link" bordered section with the two new Input fields
- "Verify & Link" button appears next to the Product ID field when editing an existing pack (not "new") and a product ID is entered
- Inline result banner (green/red) showing the product name from Dodo if found
- "Currently Linked" read-only info block (shown only when editing a pack that already has IDs and the user hasn't typed new ones)
- Collapsible "Setup Guide" at the bottom of the dialog with the 7-step walkthrough and the credits note
- Dialog now uses `max-w-lg max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto` to handle the extra content

**Below-table info card**
- New `Card` with a toggle button revealing the "Quick Setup Reference"
- 2-column mini table mapping app fields to Dodo dashboard equivalents
- 4-item checklist of one-time setup steps
- Link to `https://app.dodopayments.com` with an `ExternalLink` icon
